about: Real Vercel AI SDK v7 spans as its official @ai-sdk/otel integration produces them (GenAI-native: invoke_agent, step, chat, execute_tool, embeddings), the integration the rius SDK registers. Recorded through a scripted fetch with an AsyncLocalStorage context manager and deterministic clocks: no network, no API keys, no rius SDK. The rius SDK starts these spans through aggregatingTracer, which moves a run's total usage off its invoke_agent span; replay.aggregating_producer tells the expected-result tool to do the same.

scenarios.generate_text: generateText with a system prompt, temperature and maxOutputTokens.
scenarios.tool_loop: generateText with one tool and stopWhen: stepCountIs(2): two model calls (24/51 then 91/15 tokens) with the tool executed between them.
scenarios.embed: embed with text-embedding-3-small; the response vector is three floats.
